description: This file is a Java implementation of a service class (TaxReadPlatformServiceImpl) responsible for retrieving tax component and tax group data from a database, forming part of the Apache Fineract financial application. It includes methods to fetch lists, individual records, and templates related to tax components and tax groups, utilizing JDBC for database access and various mappers to convert ResultSet rows into data transfer objects.

classes.name: TaxReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that implements TaxReadPlatformService to provide methods for retrieving tax components and tax groups from the database, using JDBC template and mappers.

classes.name: TaxComponentMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL query results to TaxComponentData objects, including tax component details and history.

classes.name: TaxComponentHistoryDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping tax component history records from ResultSet.

classes.name: TaxGroupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL results to TaxGroupData objects, including associated tax components.

classes.name: TaxGroupMappingsDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping individual tax group component associations.

classes.name: TaxComponentLookUpMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping tax components for lookup operations.

classes.name: TaxGroupLookUpMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping tax groups for lookup operations.

methods.name: retrieveAllTaxComponents
methods.description: Fetches a list of all tax components.

methods.name: retrieveTaxComponentData
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tax component by ID.

methods.name: retrieveTaxComponentTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template or default object for tax components, including account options.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupData
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tax group by ID.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a tax group along with its associated tax components, for editing or display purposes.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template or default object for tax groups.
